confirmed_causes.effect: Selected bundles could carry some acquired sources, but unselected and failed-investigation captures did not have a complete independent route to the editor. Numeric market coverage occupied the overall synthesis.

confirmed_causes.effect: Its protected run funding began too late. The candidate now declares it before optional work, distinct from shared-provider liquidity.

confirmed_causes.effect: Fresh Microsoft and Alphabet headlines were present, but no new public Home report was produced. The earlier report remained the latest publication.

credit_investigation.billing_console: Read-only console confirms aggregate usage and available balance; export action exposed no request-level settlement evidence.
credit_investigation.unresolved: Individual lost-request usage is still unknown. That uncertainty is retained for reconciliation rather than requiring indefinite suspension of unrelated current reporting. Explicit future core completion funding across independent producers at shared-account level remains open.

enclosing_model_outcomes.implication: The enclosing failures confirm request deadlines; they do not establish zero billing for the lost transport attempts. Successful retries also cannot settle earlier attempts without their own usage.

admission_repair.owner_instruction: This is not the behaviour we want
admission_repair.new_admission_basis: Successful current provider balance plus live concurrent reservations.
admission_repair.unknown_costs: Retained at full uncertain bound in the original run and preserved account record; no zero usage or invented exact settlement.
admission_repair.closure_rule: A later authoritative balance observation can remove an ended/local-deadline-expired request from current liquidity withholding. Failed probes do not.
admission_repair.late_charge_risk: The current balance does not prove all old unknown charges are already posted. Those possible charges stay explicit and later receipts/balance changes are honored.
admission_repair.real_insufficient_credit: Still refused; a successful balance read is not authorization to spend unavailable provider funds.

candidate_behavior: Acquire a market-wide bounded snapshot in the existing twice-daily news producer; publish the existing shared news datasets and let Home consume them.
Use the existing shared nominator for bounded independent discovery, dated economic context and a retained substantive market synthesis.
Retain acquired tool captures even if nomination fails; preserve unresolved references as fallible leads.
Deliver all acquired captures and market research to the final full-model editor.
Reserve final Home synthesis/review in the run ledger before optional discovery.
Use shared plain-language guidance: numbers belong where magnitude, comparison or a threshold changes the explanation.

validation.complete_new_model_output_review: Completed personal review: corrected after-close candidate rejected; current production rejected.

spending.explanation: Every response has usage. Conservative total uses the published high rate bound and rounds each request up to one microUSD; it is an estimate, not an invoice. All initial mistaken replays and retries are included. Remaining cap cannot cover another full-capability maximum, so no further paid requests were started.

qualitative_cases_required: Pre-close current agenda: distinguish released policy reporting and upcoming earnings/inflation releases.
After-close current disclosures: inspect the full earnings and market-wide source handoff, not only ticker mover statistics.
Quiet repeated inputs: preserve current meaning while avoiding duplicate deep investigations.
Complete full-model public output: assess usefulness, chronology, missing substantive developments and numerical selectivity personally.

scheduling.dependency: Existing independent schedules; Home reads latest published datasets, with no news-completion trigger. No schedule change is included.

shared_producer_source_check.finding: Actual producer-time queries retain the broad source response. The morning latest50 spans only minutes of a high-volume feed; the afternoon page contains Fed reporting and current Microsoft/Alphabet earnings headlines. A bounded broad page alone is not exhaustive and must not replace selected-company intake. The producer retains both scopes; current follow-up remains in the existing shared engine.
shared_producer_source_check.quality_acceptance: Source acquisition evidence only; no new generated output has been accepted.
